Collar Grip

Quick meaning

A collar grip holds the jacket near the neck.

In plain words

A collar grip holds the jacket near the neck.

In Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu, understanding how collar grip connects to balance and leverage helps you make smart choices during partner drills.

Why it helps

It helps you move with care.

The collar grip helps break posture. control direction. slow passing. and set up many gi-based attacks and sweeps.

Practicing this movement gives you confidence during partner movement. You learn when to build frames, when to create space, and how to stay calm.

Start here

Go slow. Follow your coach.

Coach cue: Stay calm and keep your structure while working collar grip.

Coach says

Ask your coach.

Stay safe

Move with control and communicate early while training collar grip.

Coached rounds begin at a controlled pace so everyone trains safely.
